text:
rachel.pm: quick design check - updated console mocks uploaded. main asks: make invite flow role-first, clarify SSO wording, and make audit filters easier to keyboard-navigate
luca.design: opening figma. first impression: role-first flow is good but the invite CTA visually competes with role chips in the matrix
tori-ux: we can down-tint the CTA, and add a small caret to imply a modal vs inline action. avoid new visual weight on frequently used rows
mohit (eng): prefer keeping DOM simple for screen readers. if role pill opens inline, use aria-expanded on the pill itself, avoid extra buttons
rachel.pm: SSO label debate: short label vs explanatory. current options: "SSO required" or "Require SSO". which is clearer on toggles?	
luca.design: "SSO required" as label + helper text beneath: "All new users must sign in with your SSO". label concise, helper provides clarity
tori-ux: add aria-describedby from the toggle to the helper copy so screen readers always get the context. also include an accessible name for the toggle: "Require SSO for this organization"
mohit (eng): good. backend note: when SSO toggles, emit an audit event with type "sso_policy_change" and include prior state, new state, actor id
ops-bot: reminder: retention policy requires audit events to include tenant_id and request_id
rachel.pm: thanks. audit nav UX: users say invite-related events are buried. my sketch: a horizontal filter row above the list with chips: [All] [Invites] [SSO] [Role changes] + counts
luca.design: chips are ok but ensure keyboard focus order and visible focus ring. maybe use roving tabindex and arrow keys to move between chips
tori-ux: yes, implement roving tabindex pattern. also announce counts when filter is applied: "Invites filter applied, 12 results" via live region
mohit (eng): implementation will need an endpoint to return counts per event-type to avoid expensive client-side counts. add api route GET /audit/summary?org_id=...
rachel.pm: adding to ticket. invite flow microcopy: current "Invite members by email" feels incomplete. propose: primary "Invite by email" secondary "Select role before sending" or inline role first input
luca.design: inline role-first is cleaner UX. UI: [Role: Contributor v] [Email input] [Send]. role default = Contributor, can change before send
tori-ux: also show expiration in confirmation modal: "Invitation expires in 7 days" plus a link: "Resend invite". screen reader should announce expiry
mohit (eng): small accessibility reqs: trap focus in modal, return focus to CTA on close, keyboard interactions for inline role picker (Enter to open, Up/Down to navigate, Escape to cancel)
ops-bot: deployment note queued: feature-branch includes audit event types, new audit summary endpoint, and invite modal copy changes
rachel.pm: compact table density question: users want one-click role edit inline instead of opening a modal. can role pill be editable-in-place?
luca.design: yes, role pill becomes an edit control on focus. show subtle border on focus. need to ensure contrast of pill text at small sizes
tori-ux: confirm color tokens meet WCAG AA at 14px. i'll generate a variant if needed
mohit (eng): inline edit will emit "role_inline_update" events with before/after roles. mobile fallback: open bottom sheet for role selection
rachel.pm: final compliance ask: every audit nav route should accept view=auditable query param for automated scraping. small but required
mohit (eng): will add route shim and keep default behavior intact
luca.design: tiny copy tweak suggestion: change "Members" references to "Organization members" in modals to reduce ambiguity
rachel.pm: adding that to acceptance criteria. ok team, i'll create PRJ-5180 with figma links and acceptance criteria. please comment on the ticket with any blockers
mohit (eng): adding technical notes now
tori-ux: i'll follow up with updated keyboard interaction spec and alt text for diagrams
ops-bot: deploy to staging scheduled after review
